same step x inside wall (9.6 to 15.1) confirming wall overlap not arena
previous step just outside corner, distance 0.023, shows grazing approach without collision

counterfactual.change: Reduced single field vx from -49.99 to -5.0 keeping dt, steps=2, wall and other fields identical. Lower horizontal speed reduces per-step displacement from 0.60 to ~0.06 so corner is approached gradually and substep collision is detected, removing wall penetration.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has 1 body with high horizontal speed ~50 m/s and dt 0.01216 (22 substeps) grazing the top-right corner of a thin wall (h=0.2, top y=9.6, right x=15.1). At step1 the centre is at (15.29,10.086) just outside the corner (distance 0.023). Next step the centre moves ~0.61 left to (14.68,9.87) - inside the wall's x-range with bottom 0.23 below the top surface - resulting in -0.228 penetration exceeding 0.15 limit without a collision response. Substep splitting (0.028 per substep) is insufficient to catch the corner/top collision for this velocity/thin-wall grazing geometry, so positional correction never fires and body tunnels into wall.
vision_note: The red body moves leftward toward the right tip of the thin horizontal wall and grazes its end. At step 2 its lower edge visibly overlaps and sits inside the wall tip instead of colliding and remaining above it.
